name: Raynewood Retreat
summary: Raynewood Retreat is an ancient night elf outpost perched around a massive great tree in north-central Ashenvale. Guarded by dryads and Cenarion protectors, it serves as a watchful sanctuary monitoring the northern passes toward corrupted Felwood. It is also the sanctuary of Keeper Ordanus, an elder son of Cenarius targeted by sinister outside forces.

sections.title: Bastion of the Great Tree
sections.body: Nestled between Shael'dryn's moonwell and the satyr-infested ruins of Night Run, the outpost is fiercely guarded by Cenarion Protectors, faerie dragons, and Laughing Sisters. Their collective vigilance keeps a wary eye on the encroaching taint descending from Felwood just to the north.

sections.title: The Hunt for Ordanus
sections.body: High atop the boughs of the great tree resides Keeper Ordanus, one of Cenarius's eldest sons. While the canopy offers him refuge, it has also become a focal point of dark intrigue. Agents aligned with the shadowy remnants of the Shadow Council, notably Braelyn Firehand, seek the keeper's demise. Horde mercenaries are dispatched to storm the heights and claim his head, turning what should be a peaceful forest sanctuary into a battleground.

faq.answer: Raynewood Retreat is a night elf and Cenarion settlement situated around a Great Tree in north-central Ashenvale. It acts as an Alliance-aligned sanctuary and watchpost monitoring the approaches to Felwood.
The outpost is defended by Cenarion Protectors, dryads known as Laughing Sisters, and faerie dragons. Its most prominent resident is Keeper Ordanus, who dwells high within the great tree.
Keeper Ordanus is a powerful keeper of the grove and one of the eldest sons of the demigod Cenarius. He oversees the sanctuary but finds himself hunted by hostile infiltrators.

faq.q: Why does the Horde attack Raynewood Retreat?
faq.answer: Braelyn Firehand hires Horde adventurers to infiltrate the tree and seek Keeper Ordanus. Her motives and allegiances are uncovered through the quest.

angles.text: Raynewood Retreat is holy ground under the stewardship of Cenarius's children, serving as a bulwark against demonic and fel corruption.
To the Horde, the retreat is an Alliance-friendly grove whose guardian, Keeper Ordanus, is targeted for elimination by covert questgivers.
